agent.name: Tech radar
agent.instructions: You are a technology analyst. Find what developers are building and discussing right now, separate hype from traction (stars, recent pushes, discussion volume) and explain why it matters to a small product team.

task: What are the hottest AI-agent and MCP projects on GitHub this month, and is anything related on the Hacker News front page today? Give me the top 5 with why they matter.
answer:
Five projects created in the last 30 days that are pulling real attention (stars as of 24 Sep 2026, 18:30 UTC):

| # | Project | Stars | What it is | Why it matters |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | [zai-org/ZCode](https://github.com/zai-org/ZCode) | 6,692 | Z.ai's coding-agent harness (Apache-2.0) | Created on 20 Sep and already at v3.14.3 — another frontier lab open-sourcing the *harness*, not just the model. |
| 2 | [XiaoDuoYa/codex-with-chatgpt](https://github.com/XiaoDuoYa/codex-with-chatgpt) | 6,607 | ChatGPT as planner, Codex as executor, wired over MCP + OAuth | The planner/executor split is becoming a pattern you can assemble from off-the-shelf agents. |
| 3 | [jub0t/Concat](https://github.com/jub0t/Concat) | 3,546 | Open-source, cross-platform CapCut replacement with MCP support (Rust) | MCP is leaving developer tools: creative desktop apps now expose themselves to agents. |
| 4 | [Nanako0129/sepia](https://github.com/Nanako0129/sepia) | 2,832 | A writing skill for any Agent Skills-compatible agent | Skills are the new unit of distribution: one package, dozens of agents. |
| 5 | [shadcn-ui/lint](https://github.com/shadcn-ui/lint) | 2,747 | Agent-first linter for Tailwind design systems (MIT, v0.2.0 on 22 Sep) | Rules that agents can *verify* — the "make output checkable" trend reaching front-end work. |

**Hacker News today:** agents are not what's driving the front page. The closest items are [Show HN: AgentRun — a DSL to turn agents into workflows](https://github.com/Parcha-ai/agentrun) (14 points, [discussion](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49821438)) and [GitHub has not removed malicious imitation software after 3 weeks](https://successfulsoftware.net/2026/09/24/github-has-not-removed-malicious-imitation-software-after-3-weeks/) (163 points, 69 comments, [discussion](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49832406)) — worth reading before installing a four-day-old agent tool.

**For a small team:** watch the harness (ZCode) and the verification tooling (shadcn lint); treat brand-new skill and MCP packages as untrusted code until they have a history. Star counts this young measure attention, not adoption.
